title: submit_passphrase params
description: Opens, with this passphrase, the storage path of the last open_storage call when that did not open a storage, with db_no_passphrase or without, or else the open storage's path. The response is {"status": "opened", "storage_path": ...}, with the path it opened. Fails with storage_not_opened when there is neither, and with storage_open_failed, with reason wrong_passphrase, when the passphrase does not open the storage.

passphrase.description: Must not be empty; an empty passphrase gives the error code passphrase_required. Open an unencrypted database with open_storage and db_no_passphrase.

save_to_keychain.description: If true, saves the passphrase to the system keychain after the storage opens. The daemon never saves a passphrase otherwise.
